Single-file libraries by Sean Barrett, https://github.com/nothings/stb
(public domain / MIT, see the end of each header).

- stb_truetype.h v1.26: renders the TrueType font of the menus
- stb_image.h v2.30: loads the face images of the players (PNG, JPEG, ...)

The implementation is compiled in src/StbImplementation.cpp.
